evidence.title: I am just a text file. - by Ruben Hassid - How to AI

name: I am just a text file.
summary: Essay on distilling how you think and write into one markdown file so any AI can write in your voice.
description: A paid How to AI essay about turning your taste, opinions and writing habits into a single .md file, the interview process for extracting them, and how the file is used with Claude or any other AI.
